fixture inside stand-repeat; floors held, agent-run re-counted; stderr content-free; masks, stand layout held (intent
§Principles)
**Version:** escher-0.3.0 · Epoch 6 — Polish & ship · taken up 2026-11-17

**Intent anchor:** `doc:escher-0.3.0/intent` §Principles for this version, «Kept from 0.2.0 … The stand is the proof,
with a minimal fixture beside it where the tasks lack a case.»

- **The sweep.** Every 0.3.0 capability whose requirement is a behaviour of the running UI is proven headless on the
  stand's tasks or on a minimal fixture beside them, and the sweep records, per requirement, the task or fixture that
  holds its case and the check that proves it there. A requirement with no such check gets one.

- **The requirements in reach are v030-01…v030-17 bar v030-15.** At take-up the ledger reads `verified 16/17`, the
  one open cap v030-15 (Cold-agent bar), which the markerless entry «Cold-agent bar» (`chk-qhfbo2av`) names; this
  chunk does not take it.

- **The sweep re-proves; it does not re-claim** [inferred]: the claimable pool at take-up is `[v030-15]` alone, owned by
  a later entry, so this chunk claims no cap. A witness this chunk widens is recorded in the cap's notes at the wrap.

- **Some of the sixteen are not behaviours of a screen** [inferred]: v030-01 (the code audit's complexity reading),
  v030-02 (the README and the GitHub front page), v030-03 (the upstream take), v030-16 (records, by construction) and
  v030-14's cross-OS half (the `matrix_test` legs). The sweep's record names their witnesses as they stand, or states
  why none runs inside `stand-repeat`; which rows are screen behaviours is closed at P3 against each cap's acceptance.

- **The record's form** [inferred]: 0.1.0's `WITNESSES` and 0.2.0's `WITNESSES_020` tables in
  `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_requirement_sweep.rs` (1,109 lines at take-up) each pin their rows by
  `fn {test}(` through `source()`'s `include_str!` map. Whether 0.3.0's rows take a third table in that file or a file
  of its own beside it (the file already the one escher-written test file over 800 lines at the Epoch 5 audit, intent
  finding 1) is a P4 fork.

- **"Inside stand-repeat"** [inferred]: every integration witness the record names runs inside `stand-repeat` at this
  chunk's end; a witness outside it gets in by the leg's selection widened or by a `stand_*` check carrying the proof
  (a P4 fork). Witnesses that cannot run there (a unit test, a dev-host instrument, a CI-only OS leg) are stated so.

- **"agent-run re-counted"** [inferred]: the agent-run contract (`scripts/agent-run.sh`, contract tests
  `.github/scripts/test_agent_run.py`, `doc:test-plan` §3) states counts of what `run stand|all|session` selects; they
  are re-counted against 0.3.0's added targets and corrected where they drifted.

- **"stderr content-free"** [inferred]: the 0.3.0 verbs and roles a sink-installing binary runs — `graph`,
  `actions`, `layout`, an acting call's `caused`, and the `coverage` role — print no id, name, value, typed text or
  `caused` message on stderr at `RUST_LOG=trace`, measured as 0.2.0's were in `examples/seven_guis/tests/{host_log,
  mcp_log}.rs`; which of them those checks already drive is closed at P3.

- **"masks … held"** [inferred]: a password's or a file input's value reads `MASKED_VALUE` on every 0.3.0 answer that
  can carry a control's reading (`graph`, `actions`, `layout`, `caused`, a kept check, an explored path's check) and a
  masked `type` stays `MASKED_STAND_IN` in a recording; what is already asserted is closed at P3.

- **"stand layout held"** [inferred]: the stand's surface as `doc:layout-templates` §Surface: desktop-native states it
  (viewport, font, spacing, the screens' structure) still reads so after 0.3.0's changes (the bundled font, the select
  list, the isolated component).
Folded as hypotheses: each named artifact and line is re-verified at P3 before it shapes the plan.
